definition: Implementation Profile of the operation Point cloud to shapes, whose meaning is its activity type (activityType): the signature of the Generic Profile Point cloud to features, bound to data exchange formats.

hasAction.description: The meaning of the operation moves to the activity type https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/point-cloud-to-shapes, linked by activityType (gp:activityType). The definition no longer defines the operation; it was: "Converts a point cloud to a SAGA shapes layer of points, i.e. a feature collection."

The schema copied on each input and output that had one is replaced by the representation that realizes its data type in the data-formats register (decision D6): inputs/points -> point-cloud-las (schema was {"type": "string", "contentEncoding": "base64", "contentMediaType": "application/vnd.las", "description": "LAS (OGC 17-030r1); application/vnd.las is the IANA-registered media type"}); outputs/result -> feature-collection-gml (schema was {"type": "string", "contentMediaType": "text/xml", "description": "GML"}).

Decision D4: tool keywords removed: Point Cloud to Shapes, pointcloud_tools; 2 format keywords removed from inputs and outputs (inputs/points: LAS; outputs/result: GML); sources removed (tools, testbed, the bbox schema now in the representation's format): SAGA 7.3.0 -- Point Cloud to Shapes <https://saga-gis.sourceforge.io/saga_tool_doc/7.3.0/pointcloud_tools_5.html>; ZOO-Project Geonovum testbed -- SAGA.pointcloud_tools.5: Point Cloud to Shapes <https://host1.tb.geonovum.geolabs.fr/ogc-api/processes/SAGA.pointcloud_tools.5>; description rewritten without tool, host or testbed. Each removed tool or testbed reference remains findable at tier 4, in bblocks-process-profiles.

Corrects what https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/implementation-profile/point-cloud-to-shapes/actions/tools-2026-11-09 describes: the description sections removed then (sources, illustrations, data formats, multiplicity and the open question where present, and the Register position reference to the tier-4 process and its testbed URL) are restored. Tools and testbed stay in the prose; decision D4 applies to the model (keywords, source, properties), which carries none. Decision of 2026-11-09.

The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/point-cloud-to-shapes to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/implementation-profile/point-cloud-to-shapes, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/implementation-profile/point-cloud-to-shapes/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.
